# BMP fixture provenance for `modhash-bmp`

Every `.bmp` here is generated byte-by-byte by `gen_fixtures.py`
(stdlib-only Python 3) directly from the BMP format definition; no
BMP library writes these files, so they are honest ground truth.
Regenerating reproduces the blobs bit-for-bit:
`cd tests/fixtures && python gen_fixtures.py`.

| file | shape | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `p24_bottom_up.bmp` (118 B) | 5x4 24-bit BI_RGB, bottom-up | `a9993230c9862d5ee38b27897bf1a3e734157aac6aa2db4b169401580f8ad48f` |
| `p24_top_down.bmp` (118 B) | 5x4 24-bit BI_RGB, top-down (biHeight<0) | `330957ee4e3b5529d8d9d3234eaf4b0f8d5afdd0ea682749ac6f81eaee170032` |
| `p32_bitfields.bmp` (146 B) | 5x4 32-bit BI_BITFIELDS ARGB masks, INFOHEADER+inline masks | `9c43bb684b62699aff942a0fa13947d92338b6bfa857e4603d739c2772438a75` |
| `p32_v4_header.bmp` (202 B) | 5x4 32-bit BITMAPV4HEADER, in-header masks + alpha | `3966cad8ac31837022b809a438a9c3db5ba97eef8579a45037abd8ac53c19d20` |
| `p32_v5_rgb.bmp` (218 B) | 5x4 32-bit BITMAPV5HEADER BI_RGB (alpha byte ignored -> opaque) | `9dee21f9ac8922c09951d43269ff066c35bdcf59921f4972c95d44e2e7b78ef1` |
| `p32_x1555.bmp` (146 B) | 5x4 32-bit BI_BITFIELDS 5-bit channels (masks 0x7C00/0x03E0/0x001F), no alpha | `89142ab7a0b0bcc0063c3830065dc65e7439e7ac1972d4a1e1dd53cdbd5d447a` |
| `rle8.bmp` (1110 B) | 6x4 RLE8, gray palette, encoded+absolute+delta+EOL+EOF | `8b7ac308b7a00dac3f4bcdc169e2a56ad4473f2677e21427bd8146c58f540a9c` |

The RLE8 stream decodes (top-left origin, palette index =
gray value) to:

```
1 1 1 2 3 4
0 0 9 9 0 0
0 7 7 7 0 0
5 0 0 0 8 8
```
